title: Utah’s specialty license plates receive a colorful new glow-up
summary: Utah has ditched its standard white background specialty license plate design for more black plates, along with various other colors and even picturesque scenes.

title: Iran fires missiles at commercial ships in Strait of Hormuz, Axios reports
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards fired at least two missiles at commercial ships transiting through the Strait of Hormuz ​on Monday night, Axios reported, citing two U.S. officials.
